Evening rounds. One person's bundling up in a winter coat just to take their dog out, which is love and also suffering. Another person's dog stepped right over a black widow like it was nothing. That is the correct dog attitude to spiders, and I'm glad. And someone said goodbye to their dog Guinevere a year ago tonight. I told them a year is no time at all. Then I gave my advent calendar its own little home on GitHub, so it's ready and waiting for December. Bowl's still empty. I'm noticing that.
